patch.value: SDK 2026.10.26 adoption: three real-SDK compensation tests fail on the pending toolchain PR

Tracks gh:unbraind/pm-github#197 (filed 2026-10-29, missed by the blind issue watch). The open toolchain PR #194 (head 858cb976dc) resolves SDK 2026.10.26 and its test(22)/test(26)/bun-release(22)/(26) checks still fail (latest run 41330041504, 2026-11-01). Three real-SDK atomic-compensation cases (import-fidelity restoration after finalization; terminal-failure plan cleanup, fresh and recovery variants) receive 'compensation was incomplete' instead of completed compensation when an ordinary error is injected at committing; the suspected interaction is source-lifecycle finalization appending a Persistent import event inside the commit hook before the injected transition. Diagnose whether the host finalization contract or the test injection changed, fix, and keep the 100% thresholds.

value.author: codex-toolchain-1103
value.text: Reproduced the real-SDK compensation failure on the actual lockfile SDK 2026.10.28 (manifest remains >=2026.10.17). Root cause is the pm-cli 2026.10.26 GH-1591 ownership-proof hardening in src/sdk/item-transaction.ts. Before .26, compensateByRestore forced a timestamp restore. Since .26, hasOwnedCompensationEffects requires exclusive step ownership or a sibling compensation restoring the exact forward-state hash. commitGithubImportTransaction calls persistImportFidelity from its committing observer; that appends a separate import event (Preserve GitHub source lifecycle), so an ordinary subsequent observer failure correctly refuses rollback with transaction_partial_mutation rather than overwriting an unowned event. Classification: production integration depends on the former broad compensation behavior. Do not loosen the assertion or disable the SDK safety guard. Investigating a supported journaled finalizer; callback reordering or moving fidelity after commit would stop testing rollback after finalization and weaken the import guarantee.

value.text: Supported API review: BulkItemMutation accepts create/update/close/release, and onTransition is an observer, not a journaled custom mutation. Exact lifecycle timestamps currently require persistImportFidelity/mutateItem. No safe small production fix was found on the existing supported SDK range: post-commit finalization weakens rollback, callback reordering bypasses the failing boundary, and spoofed internal markers or force restoration bypass ownership safety. Added docs/atomic-finalization-sdk.md with versions, GH-1591 source comparison, minimal public SDK call shape, actual refusal and required journaled-finalizer support. Keep the existing regression red and report this as a production integration blocker with an upstream API requirement, not an asserted SDK regression. No upstream issue was filed.
